title: `erase plan`, `apply`, `verify` and the known-value audit need a 16 GB heap on the full archive (2026-11-06)
notes: Observation: each ran with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384`, 3-5 GB resident and 45-50 minutes per step on 86,962 fragments; the default heap runs out. Next step: stream the known-value pre-pass instead of holding every planned fragment, then measure one plan with the default heap.
